response.overview: A collection of spooky stories guaranteed to deliver chills worthy of Halloween night! First, Ash and Brock find themselves entangled with a 200-year-old ghost. In Saffron City, Ash and Pikachu face a girl with eerie psychic powers- ana a host of Ghost-type Pokémon. Then Ash must confront his fears while battling Ghost-type Pokémon for a Johto League Badge and navigating the mysterious Litwick Mansion. Elsewhere, Brock receives a sinister marriage proposal, while Harper and Sarah explore a haunted house. Later, Ash and friends take on a group of unruly appliances controlled by a mischievous Rotom. On a late night assignment at the Summit Ruins, devious ghosts attempt to trap our heroes. Finally, Ash and his friends must outsmart Team Rocket to recover an ancient Championship trophy.
response.title: Pokémon Spooky Stories
